Explicit limited structural revision of data adaptation. Preserve all accepted requirements exactly, public inputs/outputs, the first ten products in observed order, every existing external operation, its scope and execution order, conditional consent, actual search submission, each product-page navigation, actual document writing and root cleanup. Do not add ranking, deduplication or exclusions such as organic-only/sponsored filtering: these were not accepted. Preserve missing fields as null within non-null product records. This is not permission to redesign business work.

Revise only the data-adaptation composition and the references needed to connect it, using existing TaskPlan constructs. At EVERY observation-consuming stage (initial page, ready home, search results, each visited product), retain the complete producer observation separately and check its original completeness metadata. Use explicit extract mode with each over the complete bounded observationSnapshot.pages (not a flattened record collection exceeding runtime limits), or typed projections when those suffice. Process every page/record, including those absent from mapping examples. Each extract resultType declares only the immediate consumer's required observed facts. Candidate arrays per page may be empty only after observed absence. Flatten exactly one actual array-of-arrays level; do not flatten the foreach product export, which already is a flat array of objects. No raw snapshot, flat content, broad pageFacts or unrelated fields may enter a global interpret alongside its narrow view.

Keep genuine decisions global over the complete compact view, not sampled/truncated. For actionable decisions return observed candidate IDs only. First lookup selected IDs in the offered candidate view, then lookup those verified IDs in retained original records; preserve repeated selections, order and original action arguments. Use producer reference identity where available, otherwise original collection indices assigned deterministically before selection. Do not synthesize URLs/references/selectors/action capabilities. Preserve producer action compatibility: consent activation must resolve an observed compatible control; fill must resolve an observed fill target. Keep typed nullable guards and failure assertions, including original complete-snapshot checks; do not replace completeness with model booleans or turn empty/unusable acquisitions into CAPTCHA or a successful workbook. No new public inputs, fallback business data or altered limits.

Replace interpret-only normalization, field copying and collection assembly with value/field/object/array/foreach typed bindings. In particular normalize_products must deterministically project the visited non-null product records to the exact accepted products interface with minItems 0/maxItems 10; preserve nullable name, description, price and url and required index/status. Keep genuine product-field extraction source-grounded, do not invent content/status evidence or omit product visits. Any genuine interpretation must consume compact observed fields only. Preserve captchaEncountered from observed detection using explicit existing bindings/predicates and scope exports, not raw page input.

Retain ONE explicit bounded TSV-formatting interpret transform over only the at-most-ten compact product records. Preserve exact observed names/descriptions/prices, null-as-missing representation and row order, with columns supported by the current Document writer. Do not generate a path through inference. Keep the writer's fixed authorized destination and expose public xlsxPath from its successful declared filePath output, with success and non-null checks through existing typed runtime assertions, never a literal standing in for execution. Keep writer and cleanup operations intact and in order.

Stay within the issued TaskPlan schema. field selects an object property, never array index/length. Use explicit scope outputs/captures and typed bindings; do not emit JavaScript, new executors or invented contracts. Use only existing inspected operations. You may insert or replace pure data-adaptation tasks and update their immediate bindings/exports; do not drop, move, replace or add unrelated external business operations or weaken requires. Return the complete revised TaskPlan through the existing explicit revision response, preserving accepted intent.
